item.title: Ghalibaf mocks US Treasury chief over failed economic predictions
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has mocked US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent over his repeated deadlines for Iran’s economic collapse, saying the missed predictions could earn him a Nobel Prize in Physics for proving that time could be irrelevant.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has mocked US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent over his repeated deadlines for Iran’s economic collapse, saying the missed predictions could earn him a Nobel Prize in Physics for proving that time could be irrelevant.

item.title: Russian expert: Pezeshkian’s CIS proposal deals blow to anti-Iran campaign
item.description: Moscow, IRNA – A Russian lecturer and expert says Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian’s attendance at the CIS heads-of-state summit is regarded as a landmark event for both Iran and the member states, and the proposal he presented there struck a blow to the US-Israeli campaign against Iran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86292721/Russian-expert-Pezeshkian-s-CIS-proposal-deals-blow-to-anti-Iran

Moscow, IRNA – A Russian lecturer and expert says Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian’s attendance at the CIS heads-of-state summit is regarded as a landmark event for both Iran and the member states, and the proposal he presented there struck a blow to the US-Israeli campaign against Iran.
